title: Philadelphia Christmas Day Buffet Cruises Brunch or Dinner
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set sail for a magical holiday with a memorable celebration aboard our Signature Philadelphia Christmas Day Cruises. Take in breathtaking views of Philadelphia’s iconic landmarks, such as the Ben Franklin Bridge, from inside or the open-air decks. This fun-filled holiday including a live DJ, dancing, games, a fully stocked cash bar. Revel in merriment and holiday cheer with this unforgettable brunch on the water! 

Join us December 3 - January 1st for an enchanting and immersive Winter Wonderland experience as City Cruises celebrates the holiday season in style! Step aboard our uniquely decorated yachts, where a whimsical, fun-filled atmosphere awaits. Surround yourself with twinkling lights, snow-covered trees, themed cocktails, seasonal menus, live entertainment, and of course, stunning views of Philadelphia’s skyline, perfectly complementing Philadelphia’s festive mix of holiday-themed attractions and restaurants.
